title: Nasurudeen31/Langchain
summary: LangChain是一个开源框架，简化了使用大型语言模型构建应用程序的过程。它允许开发者将LLMs与外部数据、工具和工作流程连接，支持Python和JavaScript，提高了开发效率和性能。
description: LangChain is an open-source framework that simplifies building applications using large language models.   It helps developers connect LLMs with external data, tools and workflows and is available in both Python and JavaScript.
